manualFollowUps: Pages: merging publishes academy. The curriculum screen reads the new version fields only when the academy function returns them, so it is safe before the migration: until then it shows no version line and 'Publish new version' re-publishes as before. 'Move this group to version N' appears only once versions exist.

Database: supabase db push --linked only from an isolated copy of the installed migrations plus 20261024231500_academy_course_versions.sql, keeping Codex's 9 pending payment migrations from #220 (20261010162000-20261010174000) excluded. Dry run first, then supabase migration list --linked. The migration adds academy_course_versions (service role only) and four columns on academy_classroom_courses. Every existing run is filled with version_mode 'live' and keeps reading live rows. Every already-published course gets version 1. It also replaces academy_module_unlocked, the two unlock gates, academy_course_completion and academy_public_course_catalog with version-aware bodies, which behave as before for live runs. It registers move_course_version as a legacy boundary write action.

Secrets: supabase secrets set ACADEMY_AUDIO_ENCRYPTION_KEY=, supabase secrets set GMAIL_SMTP_EMAIL=, supabase secrets set GMAIL_SMTP_APP_PASSWORD= and supabase secrets set SITE_URL= are not run. The first three are already configured for academy, and SITE_URL uses the code default https://schood.online. This release adds no secret.

Edge: supabase functions deploy academy --project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel after the migration (student_curriculum, set_lesson_progress, start_quiz and submit_quiz read a pinned run's version; publish_course records the version; new move_course_version action; the curriculum read returns version labels). Deploy it right after the migration. In between, existing groups are unaffected (they stay live), but a group assigned in that window is already pinned in the database while the old function still shows it live rows. Note: deploy teacher-studio too only if it is redeployed for other reasons; it re-exports academy.
verification: select count(*) from academy_classroom_courses where version_mode <> 'live' returns 0 right after the push. The number of published courses equals select count(distinct course_id) from academy_course_versions.

As staff, publish a course and assign it to a test group, then edit a lesson title. The learner still sees the old title. 'Publish new version' creates version 2, and the group is unchanged until 'Move this group to version 2'.
scripts/fixtures/academy-course-versions.sql and scripts/fixtures/academy-homework-os.sql pass against a dump of the production schema plus this migration.
POST /functions/v1/academy-learning with action public_courses still lists the listed courses, now with course.version set.
